description: Defines an abstract class 'Area' and its concrete implementation 'Rectangle' for rendering layout management in MigraDoc, including boundary calculations and union operations.

classes.name: Area
classes.description: Abstract base class representing a renderable area with properties for boundaries and methods for union and lowering operations.

classes.name: Rectangle
classes.description: Concrete implementation of 'Area' representing a rectangular layout area with position and size, capable of calculating fitting rectangles and union with other areas.

methods.name: GetFittingRect
methods.description: Returns the largest rectangle fitting within this area at a specified y position and height.

methods.name: Unite
methods.description: Returns the union of this area and another area as a new Area object.

methods.name: Lower
methods.description: Creates a new lowered Area by applying a vertical offset.
